lines.0: Hi Aarav, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj cricket scores jaise 1 se 9 aur zero numerals padhenge. Tumhara favourite cricket shot kaunsa hai?

lines.2: Bilkul, 3 runs ko likhne ka numeral 3 hota hai. Screen par 3 collections hain—tum kitna ginoge?
lines.3: Aarav, 3 collections nahi—har collection mein 3 birds hain. Ab sab ud gaye; kitne birds bache?
lines.4: Is step mein tumne sab birds uda diye. Ab aage kya karenge? Another flies away: ___ is left.
lines.5: Haan, ek bird bacha—tumne bachi hui ginti sahi pakdi. Ab numeral par dhyaan do. Main bolti hoon "eight". Ungliyon se 8 dikhao.
lines.6: Aarav, tumne pehle “pachaas” kaha, phir apna step sudhaara. Ab ungliyon se dikhaane ke liye taiyaar ho jao. Main bolti hoon "eight". Ungliyon se 8 dikhao.
lines.7: Haan, tumne 5 aur 3 jodkar 8 sahi banaya. Tumhare ghar ka number 7 hai. Uske liye kitni taaliyaan bajaoge?
lines.8: Aarav, tumne 7 ko sahi pehchaana. Ab 7 likhne se pehle, kya tum hawa mein 7 banaoge?
lines.9: Riya kehti hai 6 ko ulta kar do to bhi woh chhah hi rahega. Kya woh sahi hai?
lines.10: Sahi, kyunki ulta karne par number ka shape badal jaata hai. Khaali plate ya wahi 6—kaunsa reason sahi hai?
lines.11: Bilkul, 6 ko ulta karne par 9 banta hai, khaali plate nahi. Ab screen par 3 cheezein gin kar numeral bolo.
lines.12: Tumne teen cheezein gin li. Ab ek nayi counting try karte hain. "Seven" kaun sa number hai? Hindi mein bhi bolo.
lines.13: Bilkul sahi: tumne “seven” ko “saat” aur numeral 7 se joda. 6 aur 9 thode ek jaise dikhte hain. Inmein fark kya hai?
lines.14: Tumne dono numerals ka gol hissa dhyaan se compare kiya. Ab card ko dekho aur apna jawab socho. 6 aur 9 thode ek jaise dikhte hain. Inmein fark kya hai?

lines.0: Namaste Vihaan beta, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj cricket jaisi jumps se 100 banana seekhenge. Tumhe drawing ya cricket zyada pasand hai?
lines.1: Cricket! Tumne cricket chuna—end mein Golu ko yahi example tum sikhaoge. 100 runs tak pahunchne ke liye kitne jumps chunoge?
lines.2: Apni baat poori karo, Vihaan beta.
lines.3: Haan, 10 jumps le sakte ho, par har jump kitne runs ka hoga? 46 se 100 tak pahunchne ke liye socho.
lines.4: Tumne har baar 10 jodkar 106 dikhaya; ab 100 tak pahunchne wala chhota jump dekho.
lines.5: 96 ke baad wala jump bolo.
lines.6: Bilkul, 10 ka jump 106 le jaata hai; 96 se 100 tak kitna chhota jump hoga?
lines.7: 96 se 100 tak tumne aage badhne wale kadam gin liye. Khaali jagah bharo: Jump to the next ten: 46 to 50 is ___.
lines.8: Haan Vihaan beta, 46 se 50 tak tumne 4 ginke bilkul sahi pahunchaya. Tumhare paas ₹80 hain. ₹100 banane ke liye aur kitne chahiye?
lines.9: Bilkul, Vihaan beta—tumne do 10-ke jumps gine. Tumhe kaise pata chala ki 20 hi chahiye?
lines.10: Bilkul sahi, Vihaan beta—tumne do 10-ke jumps jodkar 20 nikala. Ab 65 ko 100 banane wala partner bolo.
lines.11: Vihaan beta, tumne tens aur ones ko jodkar 100 banane ka tareeka bataya. 65 ke saath kya milaayein ki 100 ban jaaye?
lines.12: Tumne 65 se 100 ka gap socha; pehle 65 se 70 tak ones gino. Kitne ones hue?
lines.14: Vihaan beta, tumne 5 ones aur 3 tens jode—35 kaise pata chala?
